rca_of_the_issue.bug: Crypto widget still renders when order is paid
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1) Place guest crypto order via UI → /order/{id} shows widget + deadline banner. 2) POST /api/webhook/nowpayments with signed payload payment_status='finished'. 3) Reload /order/{id}. Expected: widget + crypto-instructions disappear. Actual: deadline banner disappears but iframe/instructions block persists.
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: OrderConfirmation.jsx line 91: `const np = order.payment_info?.type === 'nowpayments' ? order.payment_info.provider_response : null;`. `np` is truthy for every nowpayments order regardless of payment_status, so the `{np && (...)}` block at line 160 always renders once payment_info.type is set.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Add `&& awaitingPayment` to the `np` computation, e.g. `const np = awaitingPayment && order.payment_info?.type === 'nowpayments' ? order.payment_info.provider_response : null;` — this reuses the same gating already applied to the deadline warning banner (line 117).
